scope: Four assigned T-cell-state asset paths plus bounded full embedding/shared context; not a replacement denominator for the two ordinary lessons.

units.requirement: A low response is an observation; anergy and exhaustion are different proposed mechanisms rather than interchangeable names for inactivity.
The A/B fictional comparison assumes viable populations with the same independently verified antigen specificity, suitable later stimulation and responsive controls.
A has altered priming with inadequate accompanying support, followed by a controlled later response defect and compatible mechanistic evidence; it is anergy-compatible, not a diagnostic classifier.

B initially responds, encounters persistent antigen, and later has several altered functions plus compatible program findings; this is exhaustion-compatible rather than a universal clinical classifier.
C has only low IL-2 and unknown history, specificity, viability and controls; the state stays unassigned.
Viability/recovery, specificity and a responsive positive control answer different questions; no single added control alone establishes C state.
A and B are separate fictional populations, not an observed or required A-to-B transition.
Response history, a state label or weak response does not establish the antigen target identity.
Neither history, state assignment nor laboratory rescue guarantees checkpoint rescue, safe tumor killing or patient benefit.
Anergy or exhaustion does not mean every possible cell function is absent.
Progenitor-like exhausted T cells and ordinary memory are distinct contexts; the drawing does not give a memory-to-exhaustion transition.
Progenitor-like exhausted cells can sustain responses under a defined persistent-stimulation context.

The dashed descendant relationship goes only from progenitor-like to more differentiated exhausted populations in selected tumor models; it is not a universal trajectory or a measured human clinical outcome.
More differentiated exhausted cells can retain distinct capacities; exhausted populations are not uniformly inert.
TCF1 alone assigns neither progenitor-like exhaustion nor ordinary memory; compatible history and multiple features matter.
PD-1 positivity can accompany activation as well as exhaustion and does not alone assign the program.
State and measured response capacities do not by themselves establish tumor-target specificity.
Subset counts, differentiation capacity and a schematic descendant arrow do not establish a universal treatment-selection rule or patient benefit.
The three history cards and subset schematic are qualitative teaching, not empirical plots, clinical thresholds or diagnostic rules.
Provenance statements about code authorship, no model calls, private generator hashes, review and expert/learner status are historical attestations, not current approvals.
Check exact public output/prompt hashes and font/width arithmetic separately from actual browser/mobile pixel, contrast and accessibility review.

The exhausted-subset SVG uses CSS custom properties: direct Sharp render is unusably black, while a private variable-resolved copy preserves the read XML geometry/text. Source bytes stay untouched; this is a renderer qualification, not proof of a broken live page.
The complete shared directory receipt is context only in this cohort; its other artwork/task claims and original shared receipt are not recursively imported, regraded or classified here.
Both pinned inventories, previous source depth, pending files, ordinary grades and unassigned assets remain preserved; no independent/expert/owner/learner/language/main/live credit.
